# LocalNetworkEvolutionRules

**Domain**: TCC
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
Decentralized, node-level rules that modify network connectivity based on local information, without global coordination. Enables scalable, self-organizing topology adaptation in iNEST, crucial for in-network learning and dynamic resource allocation.
